notes.title: Binary Boss - Available for Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
[p]The wait is over, PC gamers! [b]Binary Boss[/b] is booting up on Steam—your lightning-fast Yes/No quiz built for true keyboard warriors.

Dive into decades of PC gaming history, from DOS legends to modern classics.
Face 1,000+ binary challenges:
Can you spot the cult hits, all-time greats, and underdog gems?
Rise through the ranks, unlock retro-inspired achievements, and prove you’re god-tier!

[b]Ready to flex your memory and instincts?[/b]

Wishlist [b]Binary Boss[/b] now and be first to know when the gates open.
Press Y to prove you’re boss, or N to admit defeat…
(Just kidding. There’s only one answer—hit that Wishlist!)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45696859/9bfe4dbab5f04fca89483764b9070a1d4755fd70.gif"][/img][/p][h2]🚀 Features at Launch[/h2][list][*][p][b]1,000+ handcrafted yes/no questions[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]80s PC/MS-DOS inspired interface[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievements, stats, rankings[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ultra-fast rounds, instant feedback[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Built for PC-only, game pad, mouse & keyboard warriors
Are you ready to show off your S-tier knowledge?
Smash Wishlist and get ready to play Binary Boss![/p]
